def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    # Input validation
    wr = np.asarray(with_result)
    co = np.asarray(call_only)
    nc = np.asarray(no_call)
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    for name, arr in [("with_result", wr), ("call_only", co), ("no_call", nc)]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} is empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (wr.shape == co.shape == nc.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    n_candidates, horizon = wr.shape
    # Normalize future-token weights per token offset t
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted future-token losses
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights * wr, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * co, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(weights * nc, axis=1)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin.astype(np.float64)"}
